name: The Fairmont Copley Plaza
positioning: Historic Fairmont hotel in Boston's Back Bay, next to the Boston Public Library and open since 1912
best_for: Travelers who want a historic base in Back Bay
Guests travelling with dogs or with family

facts.text: The hotel opened with a gala in 1912.
The hotel is in Boston's historic Back Bay, steps away from area attractions, popular restaurants and shopping.
The hotel has stood next to the Boston Public Library, overlooking Copley Plaza, since 1912.
The View Boston observation deck in the Prudential Tower is a 10-minute walk from the hotel.
The One Bedroom Suites have a living room with a decorative fireplace and a separate bedroom.
Fairmont Gold gives access to a lounge with complimentary breakfast, evening hors d'oeuvres and personalized service.
The hotel is family- and pet-friendly.
OAK Long Bar + Kitchen has an after-work drinks scene.

highlights.text: Signature Rooms overlook Trinity Church and the Boston Public Library.
The Presidential Suite has a living room with a decorative fireplace, a dining room with seating for 10 and a bedroom with a chaise lounge.
The hotel runs a Canine Ambassador program for dogs.
At OAK Long Bar + Kitchen, dinner is built around a large wood burning oven.
The gym has views of Back Bay and a roof deck to step out on after a workout.

considerations.text: The hotel's event spaces mean there is often a wedding or conference taking place.
WhataHotel notes there is no on-site pool or spa facility.
